pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. A young girl in purple learns to fit a yellow triangle into a triangular hole of a plain wooden shape sorter, guided by an adult teacher in a blue sweater who points to the matching hole. Both seated at a small table on plain stools, full figures and all furniture visible. Clear student concentration and supportive teaching gesture. Simple geometric pieces with no writing or numbers. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
